# artie_kafka_admin_user (Resource)

Artie Managed Kafka admin user resource. This represents an admin-profile Kafka user on an `artie_kafka_cluster`, which has cluster-wide Kafka ACLs, including every replicated topic. Artie generates its SCRAM-SHA-512 password; creating one waits until the password is ready. Admin users can't be changed, so changing any argument forces a new user. Requires a company admin API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "artie_kafka_admin_user" "example" {
  cluster_uuid = artie_kafka_cluster.example.uuid
  username     = "ops-admin"
}

output "kafka_admin_password" {
  value     = artie_kafka_admin_user.example.password
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_uuid` (String) The UUID of the `artie_kafka_cluster` the user belongs to. Changing this forces a new user.
- `username` (String) The Kafka username. Changing this forces a new user.

### Read-Only

- `access_profile` (String) The user's access profile.
- `consumer_group_prefix` (String) The prefix the user's consumer group IDs must start with.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The user's SCRAM-SHA-512 password. Clients connect to the cluster's `external_bootstrap_url` with this username and password.
- `status` (String) The user's status, e.g. `pending` until its password is ready, then `active`.
- `uuid` (String) The unique identifier for this Kafka user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a Managed Kafka admin user by using its cluster's UUID and its own UUID, separated by a slash.
# You can find the user's UUID with the List Kafka users API endpoint (GET /kafka-clusters/{uuid}/users).
terraform import artie_kafka_admin_user.example <kafka_cluster_uuid>/<kafka_user_uuid>
```
